source.prompt: ERP solution for jewellery business with retail POS
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
Generic retail ERP systems fail for jewelers because they cannot natively track dual units of measure (gram weight vs. piece count), dynamic metal market pricing, loose stone serials, or memo/consignment workflows. 

---

### Non-Negotiable Features for Jewelry ERP + POS

* **Dynamic Pricing:** Automatic price recalculations based on live daily spot rates for gold, platinum, and silver plus gemstone markups.
* **Dual-Unit Tracking:** Simultaneous tracking of weight (grams, dwt, carats) and piece counts.
* **Specialized POS Workflows:** Native handling of trade-ins, scrap purchasing, layaways, memo/consignment inventory, and customer repairs.
* **Manufacturing & Custom Jobs:** Job-bag/ticket tracking for custom design work, casting, setting, and metal loss/scrap reconciliation.

---

### Top ERP Solutions with Retail POS

| Solution | Best For | POS Capabilities | Key Strengths | Deployment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **PIRO Retail / ERP** | Full-service operations (Retail + Custom/Repair Bench) | Integrated POS, custom job ticketing, repair intake | Deep custom job tracking, casting/manufacturing workflows, live metal market rates | Cloud |
| **Luxare (by Diaspark)** | Multi-store retail & high-end boutiques | Integrated POS with mobile clienteling & layaway schedules | Built-in CRM for anniversaries/sizes, memo tracking, robust inventory analytics | Cloud |
| **Gem Logic** | Modern, all-in-one mid-market retail | Tablet-friendly POS, quick checkout, repair tracking | User-friendly cloud UI, RFID inventory counts, automated customer messaging | Cloud |
| **The Edge** | Established single-to-few store traditional retail | Robust desktop POS with layaway, trade-ins, and appraisals | Extremely deep CRM features, industry-wide adoption, offline stability | On-Premise / Hybrid |
| **E-Jewelry365** | Enterprise-scale operations needing full accounting | Integrates Microsoft POS or Shopify POS directly to ERP back-end | Built natively on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central; enterprise financial compliance | Cloud (Azure) |

---

### Key System Evaluation Factors

1. **Tagging & Scanning:** Verify native support for RFID tags or specialized jewelry barcode printers (rat-tail tags) to ensure fast stock takes without damaging delicate items.
2. **Loss Prevention:** Look for role-based access controls on POS discounts, metal scrap entry, and vault transfers.
3. **Omnichannel Sync:** Ensure real-time inventory deduction at POS to prevent selling a unique, one-of-a-kind piece simultaneously online and in-store.
